title: Anonymous 16125 NDE 16125
content: Baidu/Tieba forum When I was a teenager, I played on the riverside and was swept away by the tide and drowned. At that time, I couldn't swim, and I sank to the bottom of the river. I struggled hard to go upstream, but I was drowning for a long time, couldn't breathe, and lost consciousness. But after losing consciousness, I suddenly regained it. I saw my body was under the field in a vantage point at that time, about two meters away. It was like a soul out of the body, and I became relaxed and not struggled anymore. I heard peaceful music that sounded a bit similar to the ritual music of Western churches, and also like Chinese music as well, and then I saw my whole experience from childhood to adulthood through a third-person perspective; I saw my dead father, and some people I didn’t know. This playback was like a slideshow on a movie film, and its speed is super fast but the content is crispy clear, my whole life rewound in a blink of my eyes, and then a white light appears all around the surrounding area of my body. In a certain direction of the light, I remember that it should be above, there was a particularly bright opening, then I was sent out by a mysterious force from this opening. After I surfaced out of the water, I went directly to the shore. I will stop right now even though there were more that had happened afterward.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reported seeing his body from a vantage point about two meters away while his body was at the bottom of the river.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He said he became relaxed and did not struggle anymore.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A particularly bright opening in the surrounding white light (described as above), through which he was sent out by a mysterious force.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: He was 'sent out by a mysterious force' through the bright opening.

arrival.other_being_detail: He saw 'some people I didn’t know.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He was 'sent out by a mysterious force' through a bright opening and then surfaced out of the water and went directly to the shore.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Swept away by tide and drowned in a river as a teenager.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reported hearing peaceful music during the experience.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with music, rapid life review, surrounding white light with a bright opening, then being sent out and surfacing to shore.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He heard peaceful music that sounded similar to Western church ritual music and also like Chinese music.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I saw my whole experience from childhood to adulthood through a third-person perspective… like a slideshow on a movie film, and its speed is super fast but the content is crispy clear.”
